name: JSON.Text
summary: Turns a JSON scalar or flat object into readable text.
details: Arrays and nested objects are not supported by this implementation.
differences: Arrays and nested object values return an MBS error in the implementation.

name: JSON.Sort
summary: Sorts the values in a JSON array or orders an object’s entries.

name: JSON.SetPathItem
summary: Sets a value at a path in JSON text or a JSON reference.

name: JSON.SetFormatOptions
summary: Changes indentation and the text after keys for formatted JSON in the calculation context.

name: JSON.Search
summary: Selects data from JSON with a JMESPath expression.

name: JSON.ReplaceItemInObject
summary: Replaces an existing object member with a JSON value.

name: JSON.ReplaceItemInArray
summary: Replaces an array element at the given zero-based index.

name: JSON.Replace
summary: Replaces values selected by a JSONPath expression.

name: JSON.Query
summary: Returns values matched by a JSONPath expression.
differences: Only flag 0 is supported; other nonzero flags return an error.

name: JSON.Parse
summary: Parses JSON text and returns a session reference to its value.

name: JSON.Merge
summary: Merges JSON values recursively where their structures permit.

name: JSON.List
summary: Lists JSON references currently held in the calculation context.

name: JSON.IsValid
summary: Reports whether text can be parsed as JSON.

name: JSON.GetValue
summary: Returns a JSON value as plain text when possible.

name: JSON.GetType
summary: Returns the type name for a JSON value.

name: JSON.GetStringValue
summary: Returns the text represented by a JSON string or scalar.

name: JSON.GetPathItem
summary: Reads a value at a path in a JSON value.

name: JSON.GetObjectSize
summary: Counts the members of a JSON object.

name: JSON.GetObjectNameList
summary: Returns object member names as a return-delimited list.

name: JSON.GetObjectName
summary: Returns the object member name at a zero-based index.
